newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia, U.S. reach agreement on open skies.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia, U.S. reach agreement on open skies.

text.p: The United States and Malaysia have agreed on an "open skies" treaty liberalising air travel between the countries, Malaysian Transport Minister Ling Liong Sik said on Sunday.
"The agreement will provide for unlimited landings and intermediate points to continue flights to other countries..." the official Bernama news agency quoted Ling as saying.
Ling said the pact would be signed soon when several "appropriate words" were included, and that the agreement was likely to be implemented this year.
He did not provide details. Ling said the existing air agreement between Malaysia and United States was more favourable to Washington.
Malaysia's national air carrier, Malaysian Airline System Bhd's Malaysia Airlines, has flights to Los Angeles.
